headline: Pentagon urges defense firms to rebuild weapons production
summary: The department is asking contractors for plans after concerns that conflict has reduced key stockpiles.
script: The Pentagon is pressing defense companies to speed up weapons production. Officials want plans within three weeks, after concerns that recent conflicts have reduced key stockpiles and exposed supply-chain pressure.

imageAltTwo: A Patriot launcher assembly area at a United States Army depot.
